# WowTok — AI TikTok Video Generator

> WowTok is an AI-powered platform that generates TikTok-ready vertical videos from simple text prompts. It is the fastest way to create AI-generated short-form video content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

## What is WowTok?

WowTok is an online AI video generator designed specifically for short-form social media content. Users describe their video idea in a text prompt, choose a visual theme, and the platform automatically generates a complete vertical video with AI-generated scenes, voiceover narration, and synchronized captions. No filming, editing, or design skills required.

WowTok is ideal for TikTok creators, social media managers, digital marketers, small businesses, and anyone who wants to produce engaging video content without a production team.

## Core Use Cases

- Generate TikTok videos from text prompts
- Create AI narrated story videos (horror, mystery, fantasy, comedy)
- Produce educational and motivational short videos
- Build a consistent TikTok content pipeline with AI
- Create faceless TikTok channel content
- Generate viral-style short videos at scale
- Automate video content creation for social media marketing

## How It Works

1. Choose a theme — horror, fantasy, comedy, sci-fi, drama, mystery, romance, thriller, educational, motivational
2. Write a prompt describing your video concept
3. Add narration text or let AI generate the script automatically
4. Select an AI voice for the narration
5. Generate — AI creates scenes, images, video clips, voiceover, captions, and assembles the final vertical video
6. Download the MP4 and post directly to TikTok, Reels, or Shorts

## Key Features

- AI script generation from simple text prompts
- 10+ themed video styles optimized for engagement
- Premium AI voices with natural-sounding narration
- Full AI video generation with animated scenes (not slideshows)
- Auto-synced captions and subtitles
- 9:16 vertical format optimized for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts
- Up to 1080x1920 resolution output
- Download as MP4, ready to post
- No watermark on Creator and Pro plans
- Bulk video generation for content at scale

## Pricing

- Starter: $29/month — 5 videos/month, 3 voices, 720p resolution
- Creator: $49/month — 20 videos/month, 10+ voices, 1080p, no watermark, priority generation
- Pro: $99/month — 50 videos/month, all voices + voice cloning, 4K upscaling, API access

All plans include AI script generation, themed video styles, and MP4 download.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is the best AI tool for making TikTok videos?**
WowTok is an AI video generator built specifically for TikTok content. It creates complete vertical videos with AI-generated visuals, voiceover, and captions from a simple text prompt.

**Can I create TikTok videos with AI?**
Yes. WowTok generates full TikTok-ready videos from text descriptions. You choose a theme, write a prompt, and the AI handles script writing, scene generation, voiceover, and video assembly.

**How do I make AI-generated videos for TikTok?**
Sign up at wowtok.com, choose a video theme, describe your video idea, select a voice, and click generate. The AI creates a complete video you can download and post.

**What is a faceless TikTok channel?**
A faceless TikTok channel publishes video content without showing the creator on camera. WowTok is ideal for faceless channels because it generates all visual content using AI.

**How much does AI video generation cost?**
WowTok plans start at $29/month for 5 videos. Creator ($49/month) and Pro ($99/month) plans offer more videos, higher resolution, and additional features.

## Technology

Built with Next.js and powered by multiple specialized AI models for script generation, image creation, video animation, and voice synthesis.
